title: Wilkins, Stokes, and Wilson's 1953 DNA paper
summary: The third Nature paper in that issue is by Wilkins, Stokes, and Wilson, not a paper on mucin.
body: M. H. F. Wilkins, A. R. Stokes, and H. R. Wilson, "Molecular Structure of Deoxypentose Nucleic Acids" (Nature, 25 April 1953, DOI 10.1038/171738a0), is the third DNA structure paper in that issue. A nearby DOI, 10.1038/171750a0, is a different article ("Mucin Secretion in the Ewe's Oviduct") and must not be cited as a DNA paper. Wilkins shared the 1962 Nobel with Watson and Crick.
